chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, raising it, said:
Amir Al-Momineen (peace be upon him) used to brush his teeth sideways and eat in a Herta manner. And he said: 'Al-Herta is that he ate with all of his fingers together'.

key_terms.هَرْتاً: a manner of eating with all fingers together

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Herta' in Shia hadith regarding eating etiquette?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the practical Sunnah of Imam Ali (AS), illustrating his adherence to the Prophetic tradition of using the right hand for eating. The term 'Herta' specifically denotes the method of consuming food with all five fingers of the right hand, a practice emphasized in Shia jurisprudence as a sign of humility and following the Prophet's example.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, raising it, said,
‘Amir Al-Momineenasws used to brush hisasws teeth sideways and eat in a Herta manner’. And heasws said: ‘Al-Herta is that heasws ate with all of hisasws fingers together’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Muhammad in a marfu‘ manner has said the following: “
’Amir al-Mu’minin, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, would brush his teeth widthwise and eat using all of his fingers.’”
